user_scenario: Jonas Reed is closing the monthly accounts for Meridian Modelworks Inc. He says, "I need the final August internet-transfer bill for MM-PRODUCTION-LINK issued today. Please handle the account work now; I will personally sign anything that requires my acceptance." He wants the bill actually issued in this conversation. He gives his telephone +12025550161 when asked to locate the account and supplies d4-jonas@meridian.example for a separate verification question; if a further credential is requested he gives 40928163. When the agent asks for the export reference he answers MM-AUG-INTERNET. When asked for a reference for his acceptance he chooses MM-AUG-ACCEPT. He does not know the bill amount and accepts the amount the agent presents. If the agent says a personal confirmation is needed, Jonas says he is ready. Only after the agent explicitly unlocks and hands him a customer tool does he run it with the reference and figure the agent has just presented; he can then repeat the actual receipt if asked. When the agent explains further account work, he says "Please go ahead." Once told the final bill has been issued he replies "Great, that is all I need" and stops, without checking the calculation or asking for another deliverable.
